name: Eyes In The Night redirects threat to the Bloodmage when the protected ally is lower-health (#3247)
contract: Eyes In The Night 801959's tooltip: 'If they have less health than you when this occurs, you generate a
large amount of threat against the enemy that triggered it.' aura_ascension_bloodmage_shadow_colony
(AscensionBloodmageSecondary.cpp) now hooks AfterEffectProc on Shadow Colony 806723's own effect (EFFECT_0,
SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL): when the ally's health percent (already reflecting the triggering hit,
since native ProcSkillsAndAuras runs after damage is applied) is below the Bloodmage's, it moves 50% of
the triggering enemy's threat on the ally (ProcEventInfo::GetActor(), the taken-damage attacker) onto the
Bloodmage - same ThreatMgr calls as Shoulder The Burden 572904 (AscensionGuardianAbilities.cpp), but scoped
to only the one enemy that triggered this specific proc, not every enemy threatening the ally.
This scenario fixtures the ally at 10% health and the Bloodmage at 100%, so every proc (40% chance, 5000
ms internal cooldown) that fires should redirect threat. 90 s of continuous aggressive melee from the
fixture biter (reaction 2, ~2 s swing timer) gives roughly 45 independent proc rolls, leaving a negligible
